SELECT oo.id, oo.outbound_no, oo.order_id, oo.order_no, so.platform_order_no AS platform_order_no, so.remark AS order_remark, oo.warehouse_id, oo.express_company_id, ec.name AS express_company_name, w.name AS warehouse_name, oo.status, oo.picker_id, oo.picker_name, oo.remark, oo.tracking_no, oo.shipping_fee, oo.shipped_at, oo.deleted, oo.created_at, oo.updated_at FROM outbound_order oo LEFT JOIN sales_order so ON oo.order_id = so.id AND so.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON oo.warehouse_id = w.id LEFT JOIN express_company ec ON oo.express_company_id = ec.id AND ec.deleted = 0 WHERE oo.deleted = 0
AND oo.outbound_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{outboundNo}, '%')
AND oo.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{orderNo}, '%')
AND so.platform_order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{platformOrderNo}, '%')
AND oo.tracking_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{trackingNo}, '%')

AND oo.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}
